bead.title: Record vLLM CPU utilization cassettes
bead.description: Add vLLM real-server cassette coverage. In-scope files: internal/provider/vllm tests and committed testdata/cassettes, plus any small server bootstrap helper used only by record-mode tests. Record mode must install or pull a CPU-capable vLLM runtime, start a trivial CPU model on a free local port with constrained concurrency such as --max-num-seqs 1 and small max model length, wait for /v1/models readiness, record /v1/models, /metrics, minimal /v1/chat/completions, and /metrics while at least one request is in flight or queued where feasible. Replay mode must be the default CI path and parse cassette data only. Out of scope: llama-server cassettes, route scoring, sticky leases, and hand-written HTTP mocks.
bead.acceptance: 1. go test ./internal/provider/vllm ./... -run 'VLLM.*Cassette|VLLM.*Utilization' passes in replay mode using committed cassettes. 2. FIZEAU_RECORD_PROVIDER_CASSETTES=1 go test ./internal/provider/vllm -run 'Record' installs or starts vLLM itself and refreshes cassettes without requiring a manually pre-started server. 3. Cassettes include real /v1/models, /metrics, minimal chat, and under-load metrics interactions. 4. Replay parsing extracts vllm:num_requests_running, vllm:num_requests_waiting, and kv_cache_usage_perc or legacy gpu_cache_usage_perc. 5. No hand-written endpoint mocks define the provider contract.
